scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @my-poxket/domain && npm run build --workspace @my-poxket/api && npm run build --workspace @my-poxket/web
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,web "npm run dev --workspace @my-poxket/api" "npm run dev --workspace @my-poxket/web"
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @my-poxket/domain && npm run test --workspace @my-poxket/api && npm run test --workspace @my-poxket/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @my-poxket/domain && npm run typecheck --workspace @my-poxket/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @my-poxket/web
scripts.validate: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
